name: std::islower(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool islower(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a lowercase alphabetic character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as lowercase, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
islower('π', C locale) returned false
isupper('π', C locale) returned false
islower('π', Unicode locale) returned true
isupper('π', Unicode locale) returned false

summary: Checks if the given character is classified as a lowercase alphabetic character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.
